item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Functions support for .NET 11
item.description:
Azure Functions support for .NET 11 is now generally available. You can build Functions apps targeting .NET 11 with the isolated worker model while continuing to use the Azure Functions programming model and host integration.

  • Source: Azure Updates
